S2 [fact]: Use a Node.js server and include tests. [assumption]: Select a test approach supported by the discovered Node.js runtime and keep dependencies proportionate to the small game. [open question—discovery]: Which Node.js version and execution constraints are available? Establish the runtime environment first; the answer blocks the server and test setup. [fact]: This unattended intake implements nothing, and the repository is empty; discovery can proceed without a person.
